text.p: S.O.I. Industries Inc said on Thursday it dismissed its independent accountants, S.W. Hatfield & Associates, effective November 1.

The company said it had not had any disagreements with S.W. Hatfield on any matter of accounting principles or practices, financial statements disclosure or auditing scope or procedure or any reportable events.
SOI said it had engaged accounting firm Hein & Associates LLP as independent accountants as of November 1.

The company said its financial statements for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, done by S.W. Hatfield, contained no adverse opinion or disclaimer of opinion and was not qualified or modified because of uncertainty, audit scope or accounting principles.
